detail.longDescription: Neural Networks: Building Intelligence One Neuron at a Time A Neural Network is a machine learning model that learns patterns by stacking simple mathematical units, each making a tiny decision. One neuron alone is weak. But chain enough of them together, layer after layer, and they can learn patterns so complex that no single equation could capture them. Strip away the jargon and what you have is this: take some numbers in, do some weighted maths through layers of neurons, get a prediction out. If you’re wrong, go back and tweak the weights.
